links.comparator_used: Earlier/initial prompt and workflow configurations in the iterative experiments (no refinement)
links.outcome: Major errors (hallucinations and omissions) in LLM-generated clinical notes
links.effect: Refining prompts and workflows reduced major errors below previously reported human note-taking rates; overall across 18 configurations (12,999 annotated sentences) hallucination rate was 1.47% and omission rate 3.45%. No per-configuration numbers given in the text.
links.quote: By refining prompts and workflows, we successfully reduced major errors below previously reported human note-taking rates, highlighting the framework's potential for safer clinical documentation.

design_hint: prompt and workflow refinement with clinician annotation of errors
